tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md && jq -r '[.value,.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3],.stack_frames[4]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2" | "$3" | "$4; s[k]+=$1; n[k]++} END {for(k in s) print s[k],n[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s 'def stats: {operations:(map(.value)|add), tuples:length, sessions:(map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}; {repeated_bad:(map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\" and .value>0))|stats), repeated_good:(map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\" and .value<0)|.value=-.value)|stats), all_bad:(map(select(.value>0))|stats), all_good:(map(select(.value<0)|.value=-.value)|stats)}' samples.jsonl
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2],.value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)p[$1]+=$2; else n[$1]-=$2} END {for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\texcess=%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr"
